title: fix(service-automation)!: the connector pull door refuses an input key its read action does not declare, as connector_action does
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbTGhxJSYAmQXU7efVdNqrpw)_

Fixes #33894

Clause-②: no (narrowing) — a mapping whose `connectorSource.input`, or the watermark parameter the pull adds to its `query`, carries a key the read action's `inputSchema` does not declare used to pull and send that key to the provider; the pull now fails before the call with `VALIDATION_ERROR`. Nothing published widens: no export, no key, no option is added. First-party mappings affected: 0 (no `connectorSource` under `examples/` or `packages/apps/`).
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: none — `git grep -i 'connectorSource|watermark' -- skills/` has 0 hits: no published skill teaches the connector pull door's input

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:映射的连接器拉取入口(`connectorSource.input`)也像 `connector_action` 节点一样,拒收读取动作 `inputSchema` 未声明的输入键,包括拉取入口自己加进 `query` 的水位参数(如 `since`);拒绝时报 `VALIDATION_ERROR`,点名该键和修法,不调用外部服务、不写入。
- 为什么改:维护者裁决 6896271476「多余参数直接报错」:凡是调用连接器动作的入口,对输入一视同仁;以后新入口直接继承,不再回来要裁决。
- 风险与回滚:收窄。定时拉取没有 fault 边,带多余键的映射每次运行都失败(`sys_sync_run` 记 failed),直到映射或 OpenAPI 文档修好;水位参数只在目标已有值后才发送,所以首拉成功、第二次起失败。第一方受影响 0 处;rest 连接器的 `query` 是开放的,不受影响。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/services/service-automation/src/connector-pull.ts` 的判定段(打开 `refuseUndeclaredKeys`,以及单独判定水位参数以便在拒绝句里点名它);`connector-pull-undeclared-input-key.test.ts`;changeset 的迁移说明。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-automation exec vitest run src/connector-pull-undeclared-input-key.test.ts src/connector-pull.test.ts`,预期全部通过(新文件 6 个用例,翻转后的拒绝 pin 在 `connector-pull.test.ts`)。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地(合同档复核由区域安排)。

## What changes

- `packages/services/service-automation/src/connector-pull.ts`: the pull door judges the input it is about to send with `judgeConnectorInput(..., { refuseUndeclaredKeys: true })`, as `connector_action` does (ruling 6896271476: every door that dispatches a connector action judges its input alike). The refusal keeps its `VALIDATION_ERROR` 400 `input_schema_mismatch` envelope and appends the pull door's own hint: remove the key from `connectorSource.input` or declare it in the action (for `openapi`, in the OpenAPI document). When the undeclared key is the watermark parameter the door added itself (judged alone against the schema, so the sentence never blames the watermark for an author's key), the refusal names it and says to declare it as an `in: query` parameter of the operation.
- `connector-pull.test.ts`: the pin `[#33553] an undeclared key is not refused here` (formerly 385-398) is flipped in place to a refusal pin: `code` + `status` + `reason`, both undeclared keys named, handler never called, nothing written.
- New `connector-pull-undeclared-input-key.test.ts` (named by the card): the door-added watermark key. An openapi-shaped operation that lists only `query.limit`, and one that emits no `query` section, both refuse `since` naming it and the OpenAPI fix; an author's stray key with the watermark declared does not mention the watermark. Controls: the declared watermark is sent; the first pull (nothing stored) sends no watermark and is not refused; a `rest` connector's open `query` takes the watermark as before.
- `packages/spec/src/data/mapping.zod.ts` (`connectorSource.input` describe) and the generated `content/docs/references/data/mapping.mdx`: input is judged before the call; an undeclared key is refused, the watermark parameter included.
- New semantic migration entry `18.connector-pull-undeclared-input-key-refused` (entry 18 `connector-action-undeclared-input-key-refused`, shipped in 18.5.0, is not touched).
- `content/docs/automation/jobs.mdx`: the `connectorSource` run bullet says the input is judged, names the watermark parameter and the OpenAPI fix, and that a scheduled run has no `fault` edge, so the refusal fails every run until fixed.
- BREAKING changeset (`minor` on `@objectstack/service-automation` and `@objectstack/spec`) with the ADR-0087 marker and the FROM → TO migration.

**For the sync-in owner (ADR-0153 D2, Proposed):** when the pull door starts sending paging parameters (`connectorSource.paging`), they are judged by this same rule, so the design now presumes the read action declares them; a paging parameter an `openapi` operation does not list will be refused like the watermark.

## Tests

<details><summary>Touched-package suites and typecheck (head before the last main merge; re-run touched files on the final head where noted)</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-automation test`: Test Files 283 passed (283), Tests 4003 passed (4003).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-automation typecheck` (tsc + check:test-typecheck): exit 0 after typing the new file's handler (first run named TS2493 in the new file, fixed).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test`: Test Files 842 passed (842), Tests 26961 passed, 1 todo; `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck`: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`: 1 of 14 stale (`check:docs`), regenerated with `--fix`, committed.
- The four connector-pull files (unit, new file, integration through the real `rest` connector, service door): 64 passed.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (each red, then restored with blob == HEAD and git diff HEAD empty)</summary>

- A, drop `{ refuseUndeclaredKeys: true }` from the door's judge: 4 failed (the flipped pin and three new-file pins), "the pull must refuse, not resolve: expected undefined to be an instance of ConnectorPullError".
- B, never name the watermark (`addedUndeclared = false`): 2 failed, "expected ... to contain 'watermark parameter 'since''".
- C, make the watermark probe always undeclared: 1 failed, "expected ... not to contain 'watermark parameter'".

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- First pull edge: the watermark parameter is sent only once the target holds a value, so a mapping whose operation does not declare it pulls once and fails from the second run on. The changeset, the migration entry and the refusal say so; judging it on the first pull too would be a further narrowing not in the ruling.
- `connector-input-schema.ts`'s header and `ConnectorInputJudgeOptions.refuseUndeclaredKeys` doc name only the `connector_action` node as the door that opts in; they stay true but incomplete (outside the claim's file surface, left untouched).
- `packages/spec/docs/SYNC_ARCHITECTURE.md` says the pull judges required parameters and types "as a `connector_action` flow node's is"; it does not list the undeclared-key refusal (outside the claim's file surface).
- The 18.5.0 changeset for the node half ends "The connector pull door (`connectorSource.input`) is unchanged."; released text, true when shipped, superseded by this changeset; not edited here.

## Verification

- Hot-file rule: no open PR shares a file with this branch (59 open PRs' file lists read). `git merge-tree --write-tree --name-only` against origin/main and the two PRs that add sibling files in `entries/semantic/` (#33970, #34001): exit 0, no conflicted paths.
- Dogfood battery and the derived gate subset: see the report comment on the card.
